news.title: FIFA U-15 World Cup & Festival: India begins campaign with 4-2 win over Laos
news.lede: AIFF media AIFF media https://ss-i.thgim.com/public/incoming/ftuud/article71619483.ece/alternates/FREE_1200/india%20real%20world%20cup.png Chennai Macdonnish Ngairangbam opened the scoring for the Blue Colts in the seventh minute before R Lalremruatfela doubled their adavantage in the 11th minute. India began its FIFA Under-15 World Cup campaign with a 4-2 win over Laos in Azerbaijan on Saturday. Bibiano Fernandes’ Blue Colts made a bright start on Saturday morning and created two chances in the opening four minutes. A powerful left-footed effort from inside the box by Deepak Singh Arambam was pushed away by the Laos goalkeeper Anousith Souksavanh in the third minute, before Macdonnish was denied by the advancing custodian a minute later.

news.lede: Latest scores and results from the 2026 Rugby League World Cup, with Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea playing host to the men's, women's and wheelchair tournaments. news.title: Rugby League World Cup: Mikey Lewis on bench as England squad named for clash vs France after opening defeat
news.lede: England head coach Brian McDermott has made one change to his 19-man squad for Saturday's Rugby League World Cup match against France. AJ Brimson retains the job at full-back with Jack Welsby again named as an interchange, while Luke Thompson starts at prop in the absence of Morgan Knowles, who suffered an injury in the lead-up to the opening-game defeat to Tonga. Veteran centre Kallum Watkins is listed among the reserves as he chases a cap at his fourth World Cup, while Mikey Lewis returns to the bench after missing out on a place in the squad last time out. As per World Cup rules, each side is able to name a six-player bench in each game, but only four of the six players named can be brought on.
